notes.title: Small patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just released a small patch correcting a few issues.


 Improved Steam Rich Presence integration
 Fixed an incorrect interaction with ice blocks - pushing an ice block over a sunk stone that had something else on top of it, would make the ice block pass through, instead of being stopped
